acceptance: All 16 post URLs, tag URLs and blog index served at current paths (inventory diff clean for /blog/**)
atom.xml entry ids and links equal the current feed (automated comparison test)
_blog/ drafts are not built or published
description:
Map the 16 posts in docs/blog/*.md (ablog frontmatter: blogpost, date, tags, meta_description, series) to a blog collection. Post URLs stay at /blog/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.html.

Build the blog index, tag pages, series navigation and author line.

Generate /blog/atom.xml as Atom, not RSS. Entry <id> and <link> values must be byte-identical to the current ablog feed, so feed readers do not re-show old posts. Keep full-text content in the feed.

Keep any ablog redirect pages (post_redirect) that exist today. Images in docs/blog/images (7.9 MB) keep their current URLs.
